name: Let The Children Come
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the importance of welcoming and nurturing children within the community of faith, as Jesus expressly invites children to come to Him, highlighting that the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these (Matthew 19:14; Mark 10:13-14). This invitation is coupled with the responsibility of parents and guardians to lovingly discipline and instruct children from an early age, using correction to guide them away from folly and to establish a godly foundation that endures into adulthood (Proverbs 13:24; 22:6, 15). Together, these passages affirm both the value of children in the kingdom and the vital role of deliberate, loving training in their spiritual growth.
